subStrands.name: Workshop Safety, First Aid, Energy and Matter

objectives.description: Safety and first aid in the workshop: workshop rules and regulations; safety devices/equipment (helmet, goggles, safety boots, hand gloves, overall, apron, sand bag, fire extinguishers, etc.); accident causes and prevention; first aid materials, charts, posters, first aid box; application of first aid materials.

Energy: definition; energy conversion (electrical to mechanical, gas to vapour, mechanical to heat); internal energy; enthalpy of a fluid substance; PH diagram of refrigerant; states of matter (solid, liquid, gas/vapour); change of state of matter.
Power: meaning; calculation of power used by a compressor; units of power (watts and kilowatts) and heat (joules and kilojoules).

subStrands.name: Temperature Measurement, Scales and Gas Laws

objectives.description: Temperature: concept; types of thermometer (gas, resistance, liquid and thermocouple); temperature scale conversion (Celsius to Fahrenheit, Celsius to Kelvin, Fahrenheit to Rankine); international practical temperature (boiling point of oxygen, triple point of water, boiling point of water).
Pressure: concept; types of pressure measuring devices (barometer, manometer, bourdon tube gauge); pressure measurement; suction and high pressure gauges; effects of temperature, pressure and volume.
Gas laws: Boyle's Law, Charles' Law, Dalton's Law; calculations involving general gas law (P1V1/T1 = P2V2/T2).

subStrands.name: Refrigeration Cycle, Refrigerants and Air Conditioning

objectives.description: Introduction to refrigeration: refrigeration cycle (evaporation, compression, condensation, expansion); layout diagram; types and applications; principles of operation; functions of components and accessories (relay, solenoid valves, capacitors, thermostat).
Refrigerants: definition and types; chemical names and formulae; properties and uses; refrigerant flow controls (TEV, AEV, capillary tube); identification of refrigerant by cylinder colours.
Air Conditioning processes: psychometric properties of air; processes of air conditioning (heating and cooling); latent and sensible heat; saturated and super-saturated vapour.

subStrands.name: Compressors, Condensers, Evaporators and Fault Diagnosis

objectives.description: Compressors: types; construction; working principles. Condensers: construction; calculation of heat load; types and functions of liquid receiver and service valves; principle of operation of liquid receiver and service valves.
Evaporators: types; construction and servicing; working principles; heat load estimates.

Workshop practices: basic tools (hacksaw, coil spring benders, reamers, tube cutters, etc.); tools and procedures for servicing window unit air-conditioner; methods of diagnosing faults (systematic and observation); common faults in refrigeration systems and their symptoms (leakage, faulty units, faulty compressor, poor cooling); maintenance and testing procedures.
